fronts.name: Containment
fronts.description: Hold the edge of it before the rest of {world} has to learn the word for what happened.

fronts.name: Relief
fronts.description: People are already displaced. Someone has to reach them before the second night.

fronts.name: Investigation
fronts.description: Nobody yet knows what began this. Until someone does, every other answer is a guess.

fronts.name: Evacuation
fronts.description: One clear route out of {world}, held open long enough for everyone slow to use it.

fronts.name: Intervention
fronts.description: The thing itself, met directly, by whoever can stand in front of it.

texts.struggle: {front} held longer than the response could safely reach. Nothing was lost.
texts.excel: {front} was secured before the danger could spread.

naming.name: Emergency in {world}
naming.opening: Something has broken open across {world}. Each front needs a different answer, and nobody can be in two places at once.

caches.name: Field Supply
caches.description: One stored provision for a targeted push.

caches.name: Intelligence Brief
caches.description: The response leaves useful knowledge behind.

caches.name: Material Bundle
caches.description: Practical salvage returns to the Workshop.

caches.name: Recovered Stock
caches.description: What the response could carry back, in bulk.

boons.prose: The next three successful runs here cost no Energy.
The next three successful runs here return one additional normal material.
The response yields two Intelligence immediately.
